about_the_game:
Through Solarpunk Tactics, we seek to blend the philosophy of Solarpunk ideals into a Community-driven Multiplayer + Roguelite Card Battler. We are currently hard at work on several features, and we're looking for feedback from the community! Join our Discord!

  • Solarpunk Tactics is a no-RNG, pure skill card battler where you always have access to your full deck. No top-decking, no bad draws, no excuses. Every move is deterministic, and every match is a test of strategy, not luck.

  • Manage your Energy, chain powerful Time Warp combos, and outmaneuver opponents in both single player and multiplayer modes. If you’ve ever lost a game to a bad draw, this one’s for you.

  • Time Warp Mechanic: The Time Energy that you'll amass throughout a game allows you to pay for the Warp cost of certain cards. The Warp keyword lets you play an additional Card, which can also have Warp... you see where we're going with this.

  • No Randomness: We designed the game allowing for no random mechanics, every outcome of the plays you make, you can foresee. All choice, no chance.

Jump in the Time Vortex and battle other players in 1v1 duels! We organize periodic tournaments where the winner's decks and styles are immortalized as permanent commanders to defeat in single player runs.

Join our Alpha playtesting and participate in the upcoming events!

What is waiting in the uncertain future of our planet? Will we face complete extinction by our own hand? Will the planetary consciousness itself reject us due to our irresponsibility?

In the earth-like planet of Lumnia, time is a concept to be bent and reshaped. Beings who mastered this ability are called Time Weavers. One of these Weavers, Erios, caused humanity’s biggest conflict in history, unleashing nuclear havoc upon the planet.

After this almost world-ending event, called The Launch, only a small portion of the planet was left habitable.

Fortunately, the remnants of humanity formed new societies known as Factions.

Veranova and the Faction of Life

A society led by a Circle of Archdruids dedicated to harmonizing architecture, technology, and daily life with nature’s sustainable cycles. Sheltered safely behind a mountain range, they prospered in isolation for hundreds of years.

But Veranova is far from a perfect place. This civilization held little interest in military defense or expansion, leaving them vulnerable when war came knocking.

Dekrenia and the Faction of Order

Nestled within a vast cave system, the fortified city of Dekrenia thrives. Its huge walls protect the miners and workers within who toil with relentless efficiency.

This faction's ever-vigilant authority, Prime Overseer Aptos, firmly believes the near-extinction event was caused by humanity's division and dissent. They vowed to never let such a thing repeat, but absolute control comes at a cost.

Troupes and the faction of Chaos

The Chaos Faction is a roving carnival of thrill-seekers and scavengers, mutated by radiation and molded by the unpredictable forces of the wastelands.

Inspired by the passionate and fearless Muffinstar, the Scavenging Troupes are nomads who reject authority and revel in unrestrained self-expression without master or chain.

Oh, and they ride massive, mutated dinosaurs.

Meleborus and the Death Faction

Forged in nuclear ruin, Meleborus is a mutated fungal network, a vast and unknowable consciousness that hums with the wisdom of eons. It speaks in whispers carried through spores and dreams, weaving prophecies of unity and transcendence.

Those who consume the Meleborus fungus gain the power to digest any substance, from uranium to rotten flesh. Driven by The Nexus’s vision, these transformed demi-humans seek to expand its reach across the planet, spreading its influence—and their evolution.

---

Join our community, everyone is welcome!
